sam: Quick sync: Artemis asked us to run a dynamic-clock perf/W sweep — we saw a weird dip around 1.2GHz in earlier runs. @lee (Artemis HW) can you confirm whether the board firmware applies staggered DVFS or per-card throttles when one card hits thermal budget?

lee (Artemis HW): We do per-card DVFS but there's also a rack-level fan curve that kicks in ~75C. That can change board voltage slightly. We can disable the rack fan automation for controlled runs, or provide the baseline fan curve telemetry.

nina: For the sweep we want: two models (redwood-mini, redwood-tall), seq len 4096, batch sizes 1/4/16, clocks at 0.8/1.0/1.2/1.4 GHz, quant fp16/int8. Each config 2h steady-state. Important metrics: per-GPU power @250ms, board inlet temp, per-kernel cycles, and latency p50/p95/p99.

oscar: Also include KV-cache hit rate and recompute counters. If DVFS changes between iterations we need a timeline to correlate power -> perf. Can Lumen-style per-second traces work?

lee (Artemis HW): We can export: high-res power (250ms), thermal sensors per zone, kernel perf via perf_event, and NVLINK Rx/Tx counters. Delivery: gzipped CSVs + an S3 read-only bucket. We'll provide sample CSV headers.

sam: Perfect. Can you include a small header example so our parser team can validate?

lee (Artemis HW): Sample CSV header (first line):

"timestamp,card_id,gpu_power_watts,gpu_temp_c,board_inlet_c,matmul_cycles,attn_cycles,rms_norm_cycles,nvlink_rx_bytes,nvlink_tx_bytes,kv_cache_hits,kv_cache_misses,clock_mhz"

nina: Nice. For perf counters we specifically need `matmul`, `fused_attention_v2`, and `rms_norm`. Please keep counter names exact as above so our collector doesn't map them incorrectly.

dana-ops: From run orchestration: we'll need an allowlist for our CI runner IP, and an SSH jumpbox user (readonly) to kick off controlled scrapes. Also request: set system governor to performance and disable auto-boost during runs. We'll provide a preflight script.

lee (Artemis HW): We can set governor and disable boost in the firmware image for the run. We'll also tag runs with a `run_id` env var so artifacts are traceable.

sam: Action items: Artemis to upload sample CSV + s3 path + firmware flag instructions by Wed EOD. Redwood to send harness docker + preflight script + parser expectations by Tue. Ops to list CI IPs by Tue. Legal: embargo/announcement window? @rebecca-legal

rebecca-legal: Heads-up: if this bench is tied to a joint press/marketplace announcement we need a 2-week embargo window for draft review. Also a short DPA addendum limiting retention to 90 days unless otherwise approved. I'll draft tonight and ping @lee.

oscar: One more ask: can we get flamegraphs for a subset of runs (1.2GHz int8) to inspect kernel hotspots? Even a 30s perf record sample would help kernel tuning.

lee (Artemis HW): Yes, we can include perf.data samples and collapsed stacks for a handful of runs. We'll flag which runs have flamegraphs in the CSV metadata.

sam: Great. Tentative kickoff: next Thu 9am PT — I'll DM calendar invite. If anyone has critical blockers call them out now. Thanks!

sam: (followup) created Jira epic and attached the sample CSV schema. Will update when Artemis uploads artifacts.
